parameters.jsCode:
const r = $json;

const body =
  r.body && typeof r.body === 'object'
    ? r.body
    : {};

const credits = body.credits ?? {};
const transformations = body.transformations ?? {};
const bandwidth = body.bandwidth ?? {};
const storage = body.storage ?? {};

return [{
  json: {
    api_id: Number(r.api_id),

    cloud_name:
      r.cloud_name ?? null,

    account_email:
      r.account_email ?? null,

    plan:
      body.plan ?? null,

    last_updated:
      body.last_updated ?? null,

    date_requested:
      body.date_requested ?? null,

    credit_used:
      Number(credits.usage ?? 0),

    credit_limit:
      Number(credits.limit ?? 0),

    credit_percent:
      Number(credits.used_percent ?? 0),

    transformation_usage:
      Number(transformations.usage ?? 0),

    transformation_credits:
      Number(transformations.credits_usage ?? 0),

    bandwidth_bytes:
      Number(bandwidth.usage ?? 0),

    bandwidth_credits:
      Number(bandwidth.credits_usage ?? 0),

    storage_bytes:
      Number(storage.usage ?? 0),

    storage_credits:
      Number(storage.credits_usage ?? 0),

    resources:
      Number(body.resources ?? 0),

    derived_resources:
      Number(body.derived_resources ?? 0),

    objects:
      Number(body.objects?.usage ?? 0),

    requests:
      Number(body.requests ?? 0),

    impressions:
      Number(body.impressions?.usage ?? 0),

    admin_rate_limit:
      Number(
        r.headers?.['x-featureratelimit-limit'] ?? 0
      ),

    admin_rate_remaining:
      Number(
        r.headers?.['x-featureratelimit-remaining'] ?? 0
      ),

    http_status:
      Number(r.statusCode ?? 0),

    raw_usage:
      body
  }
}];

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO Cloudinary_Usage (
    api_id,
    cloud_name,
    account_email,
    plan,

    credit_used,
    credit_limit,
    credit_percent,
    credit_available,

    transformation_usage,
    transformation_credits,

    bandwidth_bytes,
    bandwidth_credits,

    storage_bytes,
    storage_credits,

    resources,
    derived_resources,
    objects,
    requests,
    impressions,

    status_operacional,
    permite_publicacao,
    permite_migracao,
    prioridade_operacional,

    cloudinary_last_updated,
    date_requested_utc,

    admin_rate_limit,
    admin_rate_remaining,
    http_status,

    checked_at,
    raw_usage
)
VALUES (
    {{ $json.api_id }},
    '{{ $json.cloud_name }}',
    '{{ $json.account_email ?? "" }}',
    '{{ $json.plan ?? "" }}',

    {{ $json.credit_used }},
    {{ $json.credit_limit }},
    {{ $json.credit_percent }},
    {{ $json.credit_available }},

    {{ $json.transformation_usage }},
    {{ $json.transformation_credits }},

    {{ $json.bandwidth_bytes }},
    {{ $json.bandwidth_credits }},

    {{ $json.storage_bytes }},
    {{ $json.storage_credits }},

    {{ $json.resources }},
    {{ $json.derived_resources }},
    {{ $json.objects }},
    {{ $json.requests }},
    {{ $json.impressions }},

    '{{ $json.status_operacional }}',
    {{ $json.permite_publicacao }},
    {{ $json.permite_migracao }},
    {{ $json.prioridade_operacional }},

    {{ $json.last_updated ? "'" + $json.last_updated + "'" : "NULL" }},

    {{
      $json.date_requested
        ? "'" + $json.date_requested
            .replace("T", " ")
            .replace("Z", "") + "'"
        : "NULL"
    }},

    {{ $json.admin_rate_limit }},
    {{ $json.admin_rate_remaining }},
    {{ $json.http_status }},

    NOW(),

    '{{ JSON.stringify($json.raw_usage).replace(/'/g, "''") }}'
)

ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE

    cloud_name = VALUES(cloud_name),
    account_email = VALUES(account_email),
    plan = VALUES(plan),

    credit_used = VALUES(credit_used),
    credit_limit = VALUES(credit_limit),
    credit_percent = VALUES(credit_percent),
    credit_available = VALUES(credit_available),

    transformation_usage = VALUES(transformation_usage),
    transformation_credits = VALUES(transformation_credits),

    bandwidth_bytes = VALUES(bandwidth_bytes),
    bandwidth_credits = VALUES(bandwidth_credits),

    storage_bytes = VALUES(storage_bytes),
    storage_credits = VALUES(storage_credits),

    resources = VALUES(resources),
    derived_resources = VALUES(derived_resources),
    objects = VALUES(objects),
    requests = VALUES(requests),
    impressions = VALUES(impressions),

    status_operacional = VALUES(status_operacional),
    permite_publicacao = VALUES(permite_publicacao),
    permite_migracao = VALUES(permite_migracao),
    prioridade_operacional = VALUES(prioridade_operacional),

    cloudinary_last_updated = VALUES(cloudinary_last_updated),
    date_requested_utc = VALUES(date_requested_utc),

    admin_rate_limit = VALUES(admin_rate_limit),
    admin_rate_remaining = VALUES(admin_rate_remaining),
    http_status = VALUES(http_status),

    checked_at = NOW(),
    raw_usage = VALUES(raw_usage);

SELECT
    c.id AS api_id,
    c.dsc_email_cad AS account_email,
    c.dsc_api_key AS api_key,
    c.dsc_api_secret AS api_secret,
    c.dsc_url_servico AS cloud_name,
    c.ind_ativo,

    COALESCE(
        u.status_operacional,
        'SEM_LEITURA'
    ) AS status_atual,

    u.credit_percent,
    u.checked_at

FROM Config_API_IA c

LEFT JOIN Cloudinary_Usage u
    ON u.api_id = c.id

WHERE c.dsc_plataforma = 'cloudinary' AND c.ind_ativo=1

ORDER BY c.id;

UPDATE Cloudinary_Usage
SET
    http_status = {{ $json.http_status }},
    updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
WHERE api_id = {{ $json.api_id }};
